scope: Clean skill artwork: long vertical edge accents and translucent side bands removed; existing effect motifs retained.
normalization: Generated square cleanup PNGs smoothly resized to 320px and encoded as WebP quality 0.92 using browser Canvas. No code-painted inpainting or recoloring.

assets.name: 速射机炮
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: targeted cleanup of ONE existing square 2D game skill icon.
Edit target: the attached icon. Remove ONLY the long straight vertical decorative background bars, side stripes and translucent rectangular bands near BOTH side edges. This includes continuous cyan/turquoise strips, broken vertical accent bars and darker/lighter parallel side bands. Seamlessly reconstruct the original blue/slate gradient in those narrow background areas, with no seam or rectangular color transition.
Preserve the central illustrated skill glyph EXACTLY: same silhouette, placement, proportions, orientation, contour shapes, cel shading, colors, highlights and existing effect details. Preserve the thin broken CIRCULAR radar arcs and short calibration ticks. Central laser beams, lightning bolts, projectiles, rocket exhaust and other foreground strokes belong to the skill and must remain intact, even when they are vertical.
The whole image should have clean blue background to the left and right around the glyph. Do not crop, zoom, shift or redraw the subject; do not add badges, frames, border lines, accent stripes, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. Preserve the original square format and opaque background. Deliver one cleaned icon.
This is the base effect icon "rapid-autocannon". Keep all foreground attack effects unchanged.
